assets.prompt: Character turnaround sheet of one adult eastern grey squirrel   (Sciurus carolinensis), the same animal shown three times side by side at the   same scale on a plain light grey background. Left: exact side view facing   right. Middle: exact top-down view, head toward the right, legs spread a   little so all four feet show. Right: three-quarter front view. Neutral   standing pose on all fours, tail raised in a loose S-curve over the back but   not touching the body, so its shape reads clearly. Accurate adult anatomy:   body about 25 cm long, tail about as long again, big hind feet, slim   forelegs, rounded head, large dark eyes with a pale eye-ring, small rounded   ears. Coat: grizzled grey back with a warm rusty-brown wash along the flanks,   face and feet, a clean white-cream belly, the tail grey with a silvery-white   fringe. Painted storybook realism: soft gouache brushwork, fur suggested in   broad strokes, no fine hair detail; not cute, not chibi, no smile. Soft even   studio light, no text.
